# Problem 1
```{r function_plot}

birthday_sim = function(n) {
  any(duplicated(sample(1:365, n, replace = TRUE)))
}

set.seed(2026)

birthday_results =
  tibble(n = 2:50) |>
  mutate(
    prob = map_dbl(n, \(x) mean(replicate(10000, birthday_sim(x))))
  )

birthday_results |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = prob)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = "Group size",
    y = "Probability of shared birthday"
  )
```
The probability of sharing a birthday increases with group size. When group size is larger than 23, the probability of sharing a birthday reaches 50%.
